protocol_checks.vulnerability_mechanism: CONFIRMED: a signed user TA could set pseudo-TA-only TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT because the loader accepted every bit in inclusive TA_FLAGS_MASK GENMASK_32(8, 2); tee_ta_try_set_busy() then skipped serialization while tee_mmu_map_param() cleared, inserted, traversed, and freed ephemeral nodes in the shared vm_info.regions list, enabling concurrent use-after-free.
protocol_checks.atomic_bic: CONFIRMED: 387b0ee39b1b8d5a8a0db68a0a4535d2d621342d is the single-parent landed commit that first introduced TA_FLAGS_MASK including bit 8 and replaced the user-TA whitelist with the permissive mask check. c7c4b6e31b3ba5b1c92a50fc00680fc07755e4ef only created the pseudo-TA flag and skip-lock path while the user-TA whitelist still rejected that bit.
protocol_checks.immediate_parent_absence: CONFIRMED: immediate parent 027f050651f1729eac3c50ecd8e8d3941463bf51 has TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT but no TA_FLAGS_MASK, and ta_load() accepts only an explicit optional_flags whitelist that omits TA_FLAG_CONCURRENT, so the user-TA trigger is absent.

findings: CVE.org currently reports CVE-2026-71968 as PUBLISHED, with OP-TEE optee_os versions through 4.10.0 affected and git commit 8794043c4065c26a2b8b1313794ba5ba5f06d296 unaffected; the GitHub advisory has withdrawn_at null.
